conversion_warnings: source_url poid=4911 (catoid=15, 2025-26 catalog) resolves to the correct program: Software Development BAS, Artificial Intelligence concentration. Confirmed via print view; URL returns 200.
degree_type corrected to BAS (Bachelor of Applied Science); skeletal source labeled it BS.
total_credits set to 180 (stated graduation minimum; catalog states a 180-182 range because three distribution courses are 5-6 CR). Lower bound used so modeled blocks sum exactly to 180.

Credit model (180): BAS AI core 30 + BAS Dev core 25 + capstone 10 + AI lower-division prereqs 25 + AI open 100+ credits 20 + ENGL composition 5 + advanced writing 5 + prereq natural science 5 + prereq math 5 + business/comm/ethics 20 + humanities 5 + natural science 5 + social science 5 + free electives 15 = 180.

Capstone credit fix: DEV 490 (Capstone I) and DEV 491 (Capstone II) are 5 CR EACH (10 CR for the sequence); likewise EXPRL 490/491 are 5 CR each. The skeletal source incorrectly listed each as 10 CR (would double the capstone block).

Capstone modeled as type one_of: (DEV 490 + DEV 491) OR (EXPRL 490 + EXPRL 491), per the catalog 'Choose one of' two-course sequences. Skeletal source flattened all four into a single count:1 select, losing the paired-sequence and mutual-exclusivity structure.

'Unrestricted Electives' in the skeletal source was a type:all list of 14 named courses; this was a mis-categorization of program courses/distribution placeholders. Rebuilt the actual catalog structure: named courses placed in their real blocks (BAS core, gen-ed business core, prerequisite writing/math choices) and the open distribution/elective buckets modeled as wildcard pools.

BA 240 prerequisite corrected from skeletal '(MATH138 & MATH141 & MATH142 & MATH148)' to OR-of-placement (MATH138 | MATH141) per the course catalog; the original AND chain was a mis-parse of placement alternatives.

DEV 108 prerequisite corrected from skeletal '(MATH130 & MATH98 & MATH78 & ENGL101 & ENGL92 & ENGL93)' to null; the catalog lists placement-by-assessment alternatives (OR), not a required course chain. Modeled as no enforceable course prerequisite to avoid inventing dangling references to remedial/placement courses outside the program.
BUSIT 103 and IT 231 list ENGL 101 placement; modeled prerequisite as ENGL101 (the one in-scope, defined course).

Equivalent alternate-prefix prerequisites collapsed to the program's own courses to keep the graph closed: AI 240 prereq '(ROBAI 240 | AI 240)/(PROG 108 | DEV 108)' -> uses DEV108; AI 260/400/405/410 'ROBAI 240 or AI 240' -> AI240; DEV 128/258 'PROG 108/128 or DEV 108/128' -> DEV108/DEV128. 'admission into the BAS concentration' clauses are not course prerequisites and are omitted.

DEV 490 / EXPRL 490 catalog prerequisite is 'permission of instructor' (last two quarters of program); modeled prereq as DEV300 to anchor the capstone after the core problem-solving course (reasonable sequencing inference, not a verbatim catalog prereq).

General-education distribution buckets (prerequisite natural science, humanities, natural science, social science) and the two open-elective buckets (AI 'any 100+ credits' 20 CR, free electives 15 CR) are modeled as wildcard pools (from.include ['*:*'] + credits, external_requirement:true) rather than enumerating specific courses, because the catalog points to broad AAS-DTA distribution lists; this is the prompt-specified gen-ed/elective modeling.
